title: Agentic induction of common data elements and information extraction from sarcoma case report abstracts
abstract: arXiv:2611.18506v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Common data elements (CDEs) support clinical data comparability but are usually defined manually. We investigated whether large language model agents could derive a CDE schema from sarcoma case report abstracts and apply it at scale. An agent proposed 72,909 candidate CDEs from 24,588 PubMed abstracts; agentic consolidation yielded 1,570 CDEs. We retained 53 supported by at least 50 abstracts and attempted evidence-linked extraction across the corpus. Processing succeeded for all retained CDEs in 79.2% of abstracts, including responses indicating non-mention. Two human reviewers approved 83.0% of retained CDEs for relevance, 67.9% for clarity, and 56.6% for correctness. In 100 sampled abstracts, exact agreement with the value extracted by the LLM was 94.9% among 1,116 pairs with a non-empty answer (abstract-level bootstrap 95% CI, 93.0-96.4%). translated_title: 基于智能体的通用数据元素归纳与肉瘤病例报告摘要信息抽取
translated_abstract: 通用数据元素（CDE）支持临床数据的可比性，但通常依赖人工定义。我们研究了大语言模型智能体能否从肉瘤病例报告摘要中推导出CDE模式并进行大规模应用。一个智能体从24,588篇PubMed摘要中提出了72,909个候选CDE；经智能体式整合后得到1,570个CDE。我们保留了其中获得至少50篇摘要支持的53个CDE，并在整个语料库中开展了带证据关联的信息抽取。在79.2%的摘要中，所有保留的CDE均处理成功，其中包括标注为“未提及”的响应。两名人工评审对保留CDE的相关性认可率为83.0%，清晰性认可率为67.9%，正确性认可率为56.6%。在100篇抽样摘要中，在1,116对非空答案中与LLM抽取值完全一致的比例为94.9%（摘要层面bootstrap 95%置信区间为93.0–96.4%）。错误主要集中在解剖学部位和时间相关字段。这些发现支持智能体辅助的模式归纳（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究证明大语言模型智能体能够从2万余篇肉瘤病例报告摘要中自动归纳出通用数据元素模式，并以94.9%的抽取一致率实现了大规模、带证据关联的临床信息抽取。
en_tdlr: LLM agents can automatically induce a common data element schema from over 24,000 sarcoma case report abstracts and perform evidence-linked information extraction at scale with 94.9% exact agreement.
